library.filtersSub: Refine by time and creation method
library.albumsEmptyDescription: Group generations into curated collections as your library grows.
library.emptyCanvasDescription: Describe an image on the left and hit Generate — results appear here with search, filters, and favorites.
library.nothingMatchesDescription: Try a different search or clear your filters.
library.craftingImageSub: Lighting, detail, and composition are being refined…
library.noTracksHint: Pick a sample or describe a style on the left, then Create.
library.noVoiceoversHint: Enter text on the left and Create to generate speech.
library.playlistsEmptyHint: Group your generated tracks into curated sets.

selectModelSub: Choose an AI model for your generation
promptPlaceholder: Describe what you want to create…
pollPausedRefresh: Still generating on the server — refresh the page to check status.
guestGallerySub: Sign in to save every creation. New here? Create a free account and get {{count}} tokens to start.
settingsRestored: Settings restored from your previous generation.
lastFrameAttached: Last frame attached as an image reference — describe the next motion and generate.
enterNewPrompt: Enter a new prompt to continue.
emptyLibraryHint: Your creations will show up here.

image.startWithImagesSub: We'll create new versions from them.
image.placeholderCreate: Be specific about subject, light, and style
image.placeholderVariation: Tell us how to change or remix the source
image.addRefsHint: Guide look & consistency · up to 8 · then type @ in the prompt
image.autoPolishTip: Light cleanup of noise and softness after generation. Leave on for cleaner social posts; turn off if you want the raw model look.

video.placeholder: Describe the scene, motion, and style of your video...
video.audioTip: On = the model can generate speech/SFX with the clip. Off = silent video (cheaper on some models).
video.blockAudioAlone: Add an image or video — audio can't be used alone.
video.blockMix: No model supports this media mix. Remove some references.
video.framesToggleTip: Animate from a start image to an end image. Turn on when you need a controlled first/last frame transition.
video.framesUnsupported: This model doesn’t support first & last frame. Pick another model or turn the toggle off.
video.framesSwitchedModel: Switched to {{model}} for first & last frames
video.framesNoModels: No models support first & last frames right now.
video.negativePromptSub: Optional — describe what to avoid in the video
video.negativePromptPlaceholder: blurry, low quality, text, watermark, distorted faces…

voice.title: Voiceover
voice.placeholder: Enter the text you want to convert to speech...
voice.noVoicesSynced: No voices synced for this model yet
voice.uploadSampleHint: Upload a clear 5–30s MP3/WAV of the voice you want to clone, then type what it should say.
voice.sampleTooShort: Sample is too short ({{duration}}). Need at least {{min}}s of clear speech.
voice.sampleReadyMiniMax: Sample analyzed · {{duration}}. Tokens = clone fee + your text length.
voice.sampleReadyChatterbox: Sample analyzed · {{duration}}. Tokens are based only on the text you enter (per 1,000 characters).
voice.needLongerSample: Use a sample of at least {{min}}s
voice.englishAsciiOnly: English mode only accepts Latin/ASCII text. Switch language to Arabic (or another) for this text.
voice.switchLanguageOrAscii: Switch language or use English text

music.title: Music
music.stylePlaceholder: Type the style of song you want to generate...
music.dropAudio: Drop or browse · MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG…
music.noVocalsSupport: This model does not support singing vocals
music.uploadTrackHint: Upload a track, then choose Remix (new style) or Lyrics edit (keep beat, rewrite vocals).
music.uploadCoverHint: Upload a reference song (about 6s–6m). Describe the new cover style — optional lyrics rewrite the vocals.
music.withVocalsTip: On = singing vocals on the track. Off = instrumental only. Some models only support instrumental.
music.autoEnhanceTip: Slight mix polish after generation (+1 credit). Helps for social uploads; turn off to keep the raw render.

errors.noVideoForFrame: No video to capture a frame from.
errors.couldNotCaptureFrame: Could not capture the last frame.
errors.audioTooLarge: Audio file is too large. Please use an MP3 under 20MB.
errors.couldNotReadAudio: Could not read the audio file.
